scripts.supabase:up: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml up -d
scripts.supabase:down: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml down
scripts.supabase:logs: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml logs -f
scripts.supabase:reset: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml down -v
scripts.supabase:migrate: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml exec -T -e DATABASE_URL=postgres://supabase_admin@localhost:5432/postgres db sh /supabase/tools/migrate.sh
scripts.supabase:migrate:status: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml exec -T -e DATABASE_URL=postgres://supabase_admin@localhost:5432/postgres db sh /supabase/tools/migrate.sh --status
scripts.supabase:seed: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U supabase_admin -d postgres -f /supabase/seed/00-seed.sql
scripts.supabase:test: docker compose --env-file docker/supabase/.env -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.yml -f docker/supabase/docker-compose.local.yml exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U supabase_admin -d postgres -f /supabase/tests/seguranca.sql
